primary.title: StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs

official_page.code_status: No official code hyperlink observed on the accessible project page. Official implementation not inspected or verified.

primary_summary_zh: StructRL保持ODE解码确定性，把随机性放在动作端点，以AR(1)时间相关噪声和按动作组限制的尺度探索。更新时保存动作及末段状态，仅回放末步，使用端点扰动的结构化密度；仿真用PPO，真实交互用AWAC。论文区分注噪位置与协方差：前者带来主要OOD收益，结构更稳定体现为学习效率，最终成绩并非总高于端点Gaussian。其证据来自机器人操作，不能直接证明驾驶策略收益。
engineering_inferences_not_paper_claims: Current World clean-x action head requires its exact sigma/velocity conversion and physical ActionCodec scaling; a velocity-head replay formula cannot be pasted unchanged.

A future endpoint likelihood would be conditional on the recorded root/late state; it is not the exact marginalized density of all deterministic-ODE roots. Last-step replay truncates the current-parameter dependence through earlier rollout states.
Current W3 dimension-mean clamped transition logprob is a proxy, not exact importance sampling. It cannot be reused as an endpoint AR1 density or compared without explicit units/reduction changes.

If proposal quality is useful, a separate registered training variant must store root, late state, raw terminal innovations, executed endpoint, old conditional density/scales and RNG; recompute current trainable memory each inner; validate all native pending materials.
rho=.8 and fixed physical scales here are diagnostic choices, not learned state-conditioned scale heads or a reproduction of all StructRL training components.

The Gaussian-versus-AR1 pair isolates covariance given the same ODE endpoint/independent innovations and equal marginal variance. Comparing either with old W3 also changes decoder history/conditional center, so it is not a pure injection-location causal comparison.

probe_design.source_roots: exact existing D_ODE16 roots/endpoints; no actor rerun
probe_design.stationary: AR1 initialized with N(0,1) at first horizon to preserve per-axis marginal standard deviation at all8 horizons
probe_design.ramped: AR1 multiplied by horizon t/4 for t=.5,1,...,4 seconds; changes horizon variance and total noise budget
probe_design.finite_energy: Equal expected Gaussian/AR1 trace, not forced identical realized sample energy; no empirical renormalization or clipping

decision_criteria: Compare feasible/strict4>=.9 endpoint counts and per-scene support, separately in historical failure and matched high control cohorts.
Use same-root safety repair/degradation and quality gains/losses versus old ODE16/Late16/Mixed16, not only best-of16 mean.
A future sampler/loss experiment requires improved failure support without disproportionate high-control loss. Positive proposal diagnostics alone are not training or NAV improvement.
